title: The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time
author: Mark Haddon
summary: Fifteen-year-old Christopher, who loves maths and struggles with feelings and crowds, sets out to find out who killed a neighbour's dog, and uncovers uncomfortable truths about his family.
readIf: you enjoy unusual narrators and mysteries that turn out to be about people.
skipIf: you want a tightly plotted whodunit with a satisfying puzzle.
